title: A Massively Parallel Three-Grid Preconditioner for the High-Frequency Helmholtz Equation
summary: Accurate simulation of three-dimensional time-harmonic wave propagation over many wavelengths requires control of phase error and efficient solution of large indefinite systems. We develop a three-grid solver based on the compact 27-point interpolated optimized finite-difference (IOFD) discretization. Its wavenumber-dependent stencil supports a fine-grid resolution of six points per shortest wavelength and an unshifted physical correction on the \(2h\) grid at only three points per shortest wavelength.
